overview: This paper systematically studies the scaling behavior of discrete diffusion language models (DLMs) across different noise types (masked, uniform, and hybrid), proposing an SNR-based reparameterization of the GIDD ELBO, a universal hybrid mixing distribution for smooth interpolation between masked and uniform diffusion, and establishing scaling laws revealing that uniform diffusion favors more parameter-heavy, token-efficient scaling compared to masked diffusion, validated up to 10B parameters.

modules.name: Tokenizer Construction
modules.description: BPE tokenizer training on a large text corpus with specified vocabulary size, producing a subword tokenizer used throughout all training and evaluation pipelines.

modules.name: SNR-Reparameterized GIDD Forward Process
modules.description: Implementation of the Generalized Interpolating Discrete Diffusion (GIDD) forward noising process reparameterized in terms of log-SNR (λ), computing forward marginals q_λ(x) and conditional transitions q_{λ_t|λ_s} as functions of signal strength and mixing distribution.

modules.name: Universal Hybrid Mixing Distribution
modules.description: Implementation of the mixing distribution π_λ that smoothly transitions between masked and uniform noise based on log-SNR via a sigmoid interpolation with shift and scale hyperparameters, including computation of its derivative π'_λ needed for the ELBO weighting.

modules.name: SNR-Reparameterized ELBO Computation
modules.description: Computation of the GIDD ELBO expressed as an importance sampling procedure over log-SNRs, including the SNR-dependent weighting term w_λ(x), the KL divergence and Itakura-Saito divergence terms, and the SNR sampling distribution p(λ).

modules.name: Transformer Architecture with Stability Modifications
modules.description: Standard Transformer backbone with Squared ReLU activations, RMSNorm without bias (pre-norm on attention/MLP blocks, plus QK-norm), attention logit soft-capping, and attention sink biases for training stability.

modules.name: CompleteP Parameterization and Initialization
modules.description: Maximal update parameterization (CompleteP) implementation that sets different initialization variances and learning rate multipliers for bulk (width-dependent) versus auxiliary (non-width-dependent) parameters, enabling optimal learning rate transfer across model width and depth.

modules.name: Diffusion Forcing with Anisotropic Noise
modules.description: Per-token independent noise level sampling for a specified fraction of training samples, enabling anisotropic noise during training that supports flexible inference-time denoising schedules and stabilizes generation.

modules.name: Conditional Prompt Completion and Context Augmentation
modules.description: Data-level modifications during training: leaving a variable-length prefix noise-free for conditional generation with masked prompt-to-completion attention, and augmenting context with random fractions of empty tokens for flexible-length generation.

modules.name: Dataset Loading and Batching
modules.description: Data loading pipeline for large-scale web text corpora, handling tokenization, sequence packing to fixed length, and batch construction with configurable batch sizes scaling according to training token budgets.

modules.name: LaProp Optimizer and Learning Rate Scheduling
modules.description: Implementation of the LaProp optimizer (Adam variant with separated momentum and adaptivity) with configurable β₂ values per batch size regime, learning rate warmup, optional WSD-style cooldown annealing, and batch-size-dependent base learning rate.

modules.name: Training Loop with Unweighted ELBO Surrogate
modules.description: Core training loop minimizing the unweighted ELBO surrogate loss (p(λ)=1), managing the warmup-stable schedule (with optional cooldown), gradient computation through the discrete diffusion denoising objective, and checkpoint saving at regular intervals.

modules.name: FLOPs Estimation and Iso-FLOP Analysis
modules.description: Compute budget estimation using detailed FLOP-per-token approximations accounting for non-embedding parameters, layer count, hidden size, and sequence length, plus the simpler 6P approximation; identification of iso-FLOP profiles across model sizes for scaling law fitting.

modules.name: Scaling Law Fitting and Extrapolation
modules.description: Fitting power-law scaling relationships for compute-optimal model size, dataset size, and loss as functions of training compute (FLOPs), using iso-FLOP parabola fitting and parametric regression, with bootstrapped confidence intervals and extrapolation validation.

modules.name: Optimal Hyperparameter Discovery
modules.description: Grid search framework sweeping batch size and learning rate across model sizes and noise types, fitting power-law relationships for optimal batch size versus training tokens and optimal learning rate versus optimal batch size, analyzing dependence on noise type and model size.

modules.name: Inference with Ancestral and Confidence-Based Sampling
modules.description: Decoding algorithms including standard ancestral sampling with isotropic/anisotropic denoising and confidence-based adaptive sampling that selects the most promising token positions to denoise based on a generalized confidence heuristic applicable to both masked and uniform diffusion.

modules.name: Downstream Evaluation Pipeline
modules.description: Evaluation harness running standard NLP benchmarks (ARC-E/C, WinoGrande, PIQA, OpenBookQA, BoolQ, GSM8k) using likelihood-based answer selection for multiple-choice tasks and confidence-based sampling for generative tasks, with support for variable denoising step counts and prior-filled context.
